confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'it suggests your automatic defrost system has stopped working. This is usually caused by either a faulty heater/thermostat' - hedged and self-corrected after the customer pushed back, so not flagged

rationale: The opening turn wrongly assumed a frost-free appliance and floated a defrost heater/thermostat fault with no evidence; the customer had to correct it. The second turn still prioritised a drain-hole check requiring a full empty-and-defrost over the simpler, more likely door-seal inspection, which is poorly ordered. Once the customer reported the 5cm split, the assistant correctly identified the gasket as the cause, advised unplugging, declined to name a part number without confirming compatibility and pointed to Indesit/parts suppliers with the model number - a sound, if slightly late, resolution that omitted defrosting fully before fitting and a paper test to confirm the rest of the seal.
